verdict.rationale: Fedora's docs claim up-to-date packages, tools and runtimes 'ready for use with just a single command' plus first-class container tooling and long support windows, which supports a developer platform story, but there is no explicit mention of IDEs or AI/ML software support, and community evidence focuses on desktop environment quality (GNOME/KDE) rather than dev toolchain or AI/ML experience. missing for 10: explicit evidence of IDE availability, AI/ML framework/tooling support, and independent developer corroboration of toolchain currency.
